title: Prototypes of the Mind: A Unified Framework for Probing the Visual Brain
abstract: arXiv:2611.15046v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning has driven substantial progress in modeling fMRI responses, yet most existing approaches are optimized for a single objective---such as neural encoding, stimulus decoding, or post hoc interpretation---making it difficult to obtain a coherent account of neural representations. We introduce a unified framework that connects vision foundation models to brain activity while supporting neural analysis from multiple complementary perspectives. Our approach replaces black-box features with a sparse, interpretable representation composed of visual prototypes, and links these prototypes to voxel responses through a linear readout. This design makes the model transparent at both levels: prototype activations expose the visual concepts present in the stimulus, while the learned linear weights characterize each voxel's selectivity. Using this interface, we identify which visual concepts drive neural responses and where they appear in

translated_title: 心智的原型：一个探索视觉大脑的统一框架
translated_abstract: 深度学习在建模fMRI响应方面已取得重大进展，然而大多数现有方法仅针对单一目标进行优化——例如神经编码、刺激解码或事后解释——这使得难以获得对神经表征的连贯性刻画。我们提出了一个统一框架，将视觉基础模型与大脑活动连接起来，同时支持从多个互补视角进行神经分析。我们的方法用由视觉原型组成的稀疏、可解释的表征取代黑盒特征，并通过线性读出将这些原型与体素响应联系起来。这一设计使模型在两个层面上都具备透明性：原型激活揭示了刺激中存在的视觉概念，而学习到的线性权重则刻画了每个体素的选择性。利用这一接口，我们能够识别哪些视觉概念驱动神经响应，以及它们出现在哪些位置。
tldr: 该论文提出一个统一框架，用稀疏可解释的视觉原型表征连接视觉基础模型与大脑活动，通过线性读出同时支持神经编码、刺激解码和解释等多种分析视角，从而揭示驱动神经响应的视觉概念及其在大脑中的定位。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework that connects vision foundation models to brain activity through sparse, interpretable visual prototypes with linear readout, enabling neural encoding, decoding, and interpretation from complementary perspectives while revealing which visual concepts drive neural responses and where.
